scope: Codex synthesis of nine completed Claude high reviews against sealed manuscripts and archived primary ratings; update reading shortlist and select a bounded 2–3 candidate revision trial. No manuscript rewriting in this analysis phase.
selection_policy: Distinguish correctness, defended premises, significance, contribution and repair scope. Do not average scores or mechanically defer to Claude. Separate duplicate underlying ideas from portfolio diversity. Narrative form alone is not exclusion. Preserve support, objections, reserves and reopen triggers.
reading_plan: Read nine full Claude analyses and reviews; full candidate texts within the nine plus the two earlier shortlist candidates without Claude. Inspect prior deep assessments and panel objections as needed; record exact reading boundaries. Verify decisive new source claims against captured primary artifacts and/or public primary sources.
novelty_limits: Targeted checks only; unavailable sources and reviewer background comparisons remain uncertain. Do not equate modest novelty with zero value or reviewer confidence with proof.
critique: Separate fresh Codex context audits the proposed synthesis and revision choices under the laboratory separate-critic requirement; it is a decision audit, not a blinded manuscript rating.
decision: Freeze shortlist and justified 2–3 originals before any later descendant registration or trial revision. Trials and blinded comparisons remain the following phase.
preservation: All source manuscripts, prior ratings, failed runs and source snapshots unchanged; new decisions append-only. Existing archive intake precedes this synthesis.
model_comparison: Astra deep, Luna brief personas and Claude diligent neutral are confounded roles/methods. No cost or model superiority inference.
